genie

Character animations

The logo mark as a character. The orange arc is its eye and the handle is an antenna. Each action loops and returns to the logo pose. With reduced motion enabled, only the logo pose is shown.

Surprise

The character crouches, jumps with its eye wide open as a full ring, lands, and trembles.

Waking up

Asleep with a drooping antenna, the character stirs, stretches, opens its eye wide, blinks, and drifts back off.

Falling asleep

The character blinks heavily, droops, closes its eye into a sleeping curve, snores softly, then startles awake.

Thinking

The character looks up and to the side, glances across, squints, and a trail of thought bubbles appears.
